# Sensitivity of held-out results (generated by `scripts/06_sensitivity.py`)

The published configuration was fixed before these checks. Every variant in this fixed list is
reported, and none is used to choose the model. For each variant the ridge alpha is re-chosen on
validation rows only. The network reuses the published epoch count (96). All models are
refitted on train+validation and scored once on the test rows.

* **Timing.** The workbooks have no measurement dates, so the 31 May / 31 Oct window ends are
  assumptions. Ending every window earlier, or dropping weather of the window that ends at the
  reading, tests whether weather from after an actual survey date could have helped the models.
* **Metadata.** Some coordinates disagree between files, and two elevations are unresolved. These
  variants remove the location inputs or the flagged wells. The excluded-wells variant has fewer
  test rows, so compare it with its own persistence MAE.

| group | variant | test_rows | ridge_alpha | ridge_mae_ft | nn_mae_ft | persistence_mae_ft | ridge_minus_persistence_ft | ci95_low | ci95_high |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| reference | As published (windows end 31 May / 31 Oct) | 132 | 0.1 | 1.812 | 1.911 | 2.267 | -0.455 | -0.747 | -0.172 |
| timing | Weather windows end 31 days earlier | 132 | 1.0 | 1.808 | 1.906 | 2.267 | -0.459 | -0.75 | -0.177 |
| timing | Weather windows end 61 days earlier | 132 | 0.1 | 1.754 | 1.843 | 2.267 | -0.513 | -0.802 | -0.229 |
| timing | Without weather of the window ending at the reading | 132 | 0.1 | 1.828 | 1.915 | 2.267 | -0.439 | -0.733 | -0.155 |
| timing | Without any weather | 132 | 0.1 | 1.832 | 1.884 | 2.267 | -0.434 | -0.727 | -0.156 |
| metadata | Without latitude, longitude and elevation | 132 | 0.1 | 1.808 | 1.874 | 2.267 | -0.459 | -0.747 | -0.175 |
| metadata | Excluding the 9 coordinate-flagged wells | 83 | 0.1 | 1.417 | 1.473 | 1.916 | -0.499 | -0.881 | -0.184 |


`ridge_minus_persistence_ft` is the MAE difference (negative = ridge better), with a 95% interval
from a bootstrap that resamples whole wells. Ridge is clearly better than persistence in every variant.
